question: Which lifetime-fixed rule package and neutral initial-state package account for the observed parent-offspring differences in formation, injury survival and the full cost of conditioning, and do their effects interact? This is an exploratory component intervention after observing the 2432 batch, not a confirmatory independent replication or pure morphology mediation.

component_contract.rule: Copy the two authoritative kernel arrays and entire body_rule (both responses and their mixture) exactly from the declared rule source. No new kernel normalization, interpolation, radial mutation or parameter tuning.
component_contract.initial: Copy rho0 exactly from the initial source; use ce2 build_life0 for the original neutral energy=.8rho, founder_mass and polarity, requiring exact equality to the corresponding source initial fields. P/F and every other environmental/neutral field remain the family reference. Do not transplant an acquired state.
component_contract.field_check: Before any forward, compare all 18 fields/config to the declared source combination; incompatible non-target fields reject this candidate and are reported, not silently repaired or substituted. Equal total M/E, grid96, zero exterior and integer-offset kernels remain. Rule and initial source identity must both be recorded.
component_contract.identity: Use content-addressed IDs and record both source IDs/hashes plus explicit rule/initial selector and named gene provenance; snapshot arrays are authoritative. Do not pretend a generic rematerialization is byte-identical when it renormalizes unchanged components.
component_contract.scope: Initial intervention includes the associated neutral energy/founder/polarity distribution, not geometry alone; rule package is not separated into individual genes. Each individual keeps its rule fixed throughout life.

physics.embedding: Literal components from the already frozen new96 life0 exports; original central16:80/zero exterior and integer kernel offsets remain. Each new combination undergoes all128 formation steps; no reached-state prefix substitution.

branch_semantics: Each of four new rule/initial combinations starts at life0. Bind T00 before the first step and form once through128.
At128 independently restore full ready into naive and experienced T11 acquisitions129..160, preserving all carried fields and accounts. Only resource capability switches; lifetime rule remains fixed.
Experienced alone receives10%+x before129 and145; each history at160 independently forks none and20%+x before161 through224.
Two acquisitions and four futures per new candidate. No new low_cost_T00 acquisition/future. Old low_cost_T00 evidence remains sealed context.
Use original InteractionRuntime restoration for exact flags and atomic ready; no acquired-state reset, resupply, rule switch, shared mutable siblings or unknown-inflight replay.

execution_controls.read_control_before_submit: research.desired_state must be running and research.started true; obey pause/stop at boundaries
execution_controls.attempt_accounting: all attempted native steps count, failed attempts cannot be replaced outside cap; old completed caps untouched
execution_controls.new_binding_checks: Only new component-combination identity/loader and necessary dispatch boundaries; reuse unchanged T00/T11/ready checks, do not rerun old suites.
execution_controls.restore_boundary: complete atomic ready only; unknown inflight rejects, no automatic physical replay
execution_controls.early_extinction: keep all scheduled absolute endpoints and zero tails; dead/invalid candidates retained as failures, no substitutes or rescue parameter changes

old_controls: For each family, rule-parent/initial-parent and rule-offspring/initial-offspring are the completed 2432 candidate paths. Reuse exactly their formation, naive/experienced acquisitions and none/x futures; no old path replay. Old low_cost_T00 paths remain archived context; no new T00 follow-up arm.

reporting.factorial: Within each family and matched history/challenge retain all four absolute trajectories, rule simple effects at each initial state, initial simple effects at each rule, and R1I1-R1I0-R0I1+R0I0. Keep endpoints M/E, 0..224 and128..224 body-time, birth/death, actual removed M/E and all EU/F accounts. Complete cumulative/fixed/negative windows stay in source; use a concise synthesis.
reporting.experience: For every combination show experienced-minus-naive with the acquisition included, none and x separately. Differences of injury penalties remain diagnostics, not adaptive selection. Keep fixed frozen archive criteria unchanged; component effect does not establish memory/learning.
reporting.dynamic: Keep original-coordinate common-scale formation and injured raw sequences; retain early failures and complete zero tails. Measure whether compact double-peak vs open/ring outcomes and multi-ring growth associate with rule or initialization; do not pre-label outcomes or select only favorable frames.
reporting.limits: Shared tape, two deliberately selected families, dependent branches and actual cut-dose differences. Body-time includes scale; no independent replication, stable recovery or long-term safety inference.

execution_handoff: d3 exports the four exact combinations at cap0 and freezes SHA manifest; ce2 consumes that handoff, performs only necessary new loader/dispatch checks, records concrete candidate/plan/source SHA, then may submit the one1792 job under this authorization without another PI approval. Re-read research.desired_state and started before submission and each long stage. If source semantics or cost differ, stop and report; no replacement candidate/extra budget/retry outside cap.
